description: Defines internal x86 memory management unit (MMU) interface, including page table flags, functions for manipulating page tables, and architecture-specific constants for x86 MMU handling within Zephyr OS.

methods.name: z_x86_cr3_set
methods.description: Sets the CR3 register to a physical address for paging.

methods.name: z_x86_cr3_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the CR3 register.

methods.name: z_x86_page_tables_get
methods.description: Returns the virtual address of the current page tables.

methods.name: z_x86_cr2_get
methods.description: Returns the linear address from CR2 register during a page fault.

methods.name: z_x86_swap_update_common_page_table
methods.description: Updates the common page table for a given thread (architecture-specific).

methods.name: z_x86_mmu_init
methods.description: Initializes early-boot paging setup for x86 architecture.
